description: Winged Cat default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/winged_cat-character-sheet.png (intake.json swatch chips 24,180,60 / 18,106,41 / 245,44,29 / 69,27,18 / 245,237,229 + direct medians of the drawn surfaces, sample px cited per region). A bright-green sitting cat with cream inner ears, white almond eyes with black slit pupils, an open cream-white mouth with two white fangs, a fluffy red-orange collar, two bright-green leaf / bat wings with dark-green roots + veins, and a dark-brown broom / fan tail with darker layer lines. The black ink outline is drawing style and is not a region. No glow (the sheet draws none): every region writes zero Glow.
